Convention specifications¶

ConventionsManager manages the local SOFA convention specification registry. It can inspect, add, delete, import, and export convention specifications.

Import¶

from hrtfpykit.sofa import ConventionsManager

Examples¶

List registered convention families and versions:

ConventionsManager.available_conventions_specifications()

Inspect one specification:

spec = ConventionsManager.inspect_sofa_specification(
    "SimpleFreeFieldHRIR",
    "1.2",
)

Export a specification:

ConventionsManager.export_convention_specification_json(
    "SimpleFreeFieldHRIR",
    "1.2",
    "SimpleFreeFieldHRIR-1.2.json",
)

API reference¶

class hrtfpykit.sofa.ConventionsManager¶

CRUD and import/export for SOFA convention specifications.

Spec¶

alias of dict[str, dict[str, Any]]

static available_conventions_specifications()¶

Print the list of available SOFA conventions and versions.

The table is built from the local CONVENTIONS registry.

Raises:

ValueError – If no conventions are registered.

Return type:

None

static inspect_sofa_specification(name, version)¶

Return a convention specification.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Convention name.

  • version (str) – Convention version.

Returns:

Convention specification dictionary.

Return type:

ConventionsManager.Spec

Raises:

KeyError – If the requested convention name or version is not registered.

static add_convention_specification(name, version, spec, *, overwrite=False)¶

Add or update a convention specification.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Convention name.

  • version (str) – Convention version.

  • spec (Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]) – Convention specification to store.

  • overwrite (bool, optional) – If True, allow overwriting an existing version.

Raises:

ValueError – If spec is invalid or if the version already exists and overwrite is False.

Return type:

None

static delete_convention_specification_version(name, version)¶

Delete a specific version of a convention.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Convention name.

  • version (str) – Convention version to remove.

Raises:

KeyError – If the requested convention version does not exist.

Return type:

None

static delete_convention_specification(name)¶

Delete a convention and all of its versions.

Parameters:

name (str) – Convention name.

Raises:

KeyError – If the requested convention does not exist.

Return type:

None

static export_convention_specification_json(name, version, path)¶

Export a convention specification to JSON.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Convention name.

  • version (str) – Convention version.

  • path (str | Path) – Destination file path.

Raises:

  • KeyError – If the requested convention name or version is not registered.

  • OSError – If the JSON payload cannot be written to path.

Return type:

None

static add_convention_specification_from_json(path, *, overwrite=False)¶

Register conventions from a JSON file.

The JSON can be either: - {“convention”: “…”, “version”: “…”, “spec”: {…}} - {“registry”: { “Name”: { “1.0”: {…}, … } } }

Parameters:

  • path (str | Path) – Path to the JSON file.

  • overwrite (bool, optional) – If True, allow overwriting existing versions.

Raises:

  • FileNotFoundError – If path does not exist.

  • ValueError – If the JSON payload is malformed, contains invalid registry entries, or conflicts with existing versions while overwrite is False.

Return type:

None
